steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Voltages above 50 V AC or 120 V DC are considered hazardous; always work on low-voltage circuits when possible. | Key Fact: Isolation means disconnecting equipment from all energy sources before working on it; use lock-out/tag-out procedures. | Key Fact: An earth bond provides a low-resistance path for fault currents, causing protective devices (fuses, MCBs) to operate quickly. | Key Fact: Double-insulated equipment (Class II) has reinforced insulation and no earth connection; identified by the square-within-square symbol.
